items.title: SK Hynix’s Solidigm Weighs IPO That Could Raise $15 Billion, Report Says
items.summary: The IPO could raise about $15 billion and value Solidigm at as much as $150 billion, the report said.  “Solidigm is reviewing various options to strengthen its business competitiveness, but no specific plans have been confirmed at this time,” an SK Hynix spokesperson said in a statement.  The potential IPO would mark a deeper push into the U.S. public market for SK Hynix, which is the world’s leading memory chip maker by revenue.

items.title: Our Pick Of The Best Growth Stocks In September 2026
